subject.title: Feature Request: Pre-tool-call routing hook for model delegation

question: Should OpenClaw expose pre-tool model/session routing as an additive plugin/runtime API, and what authority plus context boundary must that API enforce?
rationale: Source inspection proves the capability is missing, but the requested API crosses plugin trust, provider/auth routing, model selection, transcript continuity, fallback, audit, and session-state boundaries that require maintainer product direction.

options.title: Design a typed routing phase
options.body: Add or extend a pre-tool routing contract only after defining allowed context, redirect targets, auth/fallback behavior, audit logs, and failure semantics.

options.title: Keep hooks params-only
options.body: Leave `before_tool_call` limited to params/block/approval and require prompt-time model hooks, capability-specific model config, or explicit subagents for routing.

options.title: Split context from routing
options.body: First add narrowly gated assistant/tool context visibility, then revisit model/session redirection after security review.

recommendation.title: Design a typed routing phase
recommendation.body: Add or extend a pre-tool routing contract only after defining allowed context, redirect targets, auth/fallback behavior, audit logs, and failure semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already reviewed this exact boundary in the issue discussion and has adjacent model-hook provenance.
